newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Pao de Acucar plans Level 3 ADR -report.
newsitem.headline: Pao de Acucar plans Level 3 ADR -report.

text.p: Brazilian supermarket chain Pao de Acucar said it plans to launch a Level Three American Depositary Receipt (ADR) program later this month, a local news agency said.
InvestNews, quoting Pao de Acucar group Directing Superintendent Luiz Antonio Viana, said the company plans to issue 140 million reais in shares to back the ADR issue.
He was quoted as saying company officials will start a roadshow next Tuesday to promote the issue in Sao Paulo, Brasilia, Europe and the United States and expect to close the deal by May 29.
"We will be the first (Brazilian) retail company to trade shares on a bolsa in the United States," he was quoted as saying.
Shares of Pao de Acucar, known formally as Companhia Brasiliera de Distribuicao, now trade over-the-counter as a Level One ADR, the agency said.
